1. SOLID Principles Scorecard

SOLID PrincipleAudit StatusImplementation Mechanism
S - Single Responsibility (SRP) 100% COMPLIANT Publishers separated into WhatsAppChannelPublisher, InstagramChannelPublisher, FacebookChannelPublisher.
O - Open/Closed (OCP) 100% COMPLIANT MultiChannelDispatchFacade auto-detects all SocialChannelPublisher Spring beans. Adding a channel requires ZERO code changes to existing code.
L - Liskov Substitution (LSP) 100% COMPLIANT All publishers strictly adhere to the SocialChannelPublisher contract and are 100% interchangeable.
I - Interface Segregation (ISP) 100% COMPLIANT Granular focused interfaces created: AiContentGenerator, PosterRenderer, SocialChannelPublisher.
D - Dependency Inversion (DIP) 100% COMPLIANT Controllers and Schedulers depend strictly on interface abstractions rather than concrete classes.

2. Code Proof: Open/Closed Principle (OCP) & Dependency Inversion (DIP)

// OCP & DIP Compliant Dispatcher Facade
@Service
public class MultiChannelDispatchFacade {

    private final List<SocialChannelPublisher> publishers;

    // Automatically injects all Spring beans implementing SocialChannelPublisher!
    public MultiChannelDispatchFacade(List<SocialChannelPublisher> publishers) {
        this.publishers = publishers;
    }

    public void dispatchToAllChannels(ContentPayloadRecord payload, File posterFile) {
        for (SocialChannelPublisher publisher : publishers) {
            if (publisher.isEnabled()) {
                publisher.publish(payload, posterFile);
            }
        }
    }
}

3. Design Patterns Applied

  • Facade Pattern: MultiChannelDispatchFacade simplifies multi-channel dispatch operations.
  • Strategy Pattern: SocialChannelPublisher implementations provide pluggable publication strategies.
  • Factory & Builder Pattern: Java2DPosterRenderer & ContentPayloadRecord build immutable Java 24 objects cleanly.
  • Dependency Injection: Spring Framework IoC container manages dependencies following DIP.
